intended_object: Right division x ↦ x / a by a fixed element a in an ordered group, viewed as an order isomorphism (additively, x ↦ x - a). Inferred from the docstring.
explanation: The underlying bijection is Equiv.divRight a, and the order condition comes from div_le_div_iff_right (b / a ≤ c / a ↔ b ≤ c), which holds in any group with a relation ≤ in which multiplying on the right is monotone (MulRightMono). This is the weakest natural setting: a group is needed for division to be a bijection, and right-monotonicity is exactly what makes the map and its inverse preserve order. No unnecessary hypotheses are imposed, such as a partial order or commutativity. It is the standard Mathlib declaration of this object.
